results.outcomeText: Australia defeated Zimbabwe by 84 runs.
results.recapText: Travis Head made 112 from 84 balls as Australia posted 6/356. That batting platform secured an unassailable 2–0 series lead, although Billy Stanlake’s injury interrupted his return.

results.outcomeText: Australia defeated Zimbabwe by one wicket.
results.recapText: Nathan Ellis and Spencer Johnson added an unbeaten 27 for the last wicket, completing the chase with one ball remaining. Josh Inglis had made a century before the tail finished the job, sealing a 3–0 series sweep.

results.outcomeText: Richmond defeated GWS GIANTS by seven points, 68–61.
results.recapText: Richmond’s 55–18 half-time lead came under threat when GWS kicked six third-quarter goals, including two from Georgia Garnett. The Tigers held on despite their wayward finishing: 9.14 to the Giants’ 10.1.

results.outcomeText: Socceroos and Brazil drew 1-1 in Townsville.
results.recapText: Nestory Irankunda's 68th-minute free kick put Australia ahead, but Rayan headed in Brazil's equaliser in stoppage time. Australia's front-foot approach created chances throughout, while Marcus Younis made his international debut off the bench.
results.selectedSentence: Irankunda's attacking role and Australia's response to Brazil's technical quality frame the Townsville review.
results.fullSpiel: The opening match of the Queensland series put Tony Popovic's side against Brazil before their Brisbane meeting. This review focuses on Australia's attacking intent, the midfield changes and Marcus Younis's international debut; the decisive moments remain in the revealed recap.
